+RACKETEERING_00.es: actividad delictiva organizada con fines de lucro

open_questions: +ILLNESS_00 after +DO_00: no automatic verb; 'cause' only once the postulate is confirmed to be causal (otherwise use the event actually meant)
+DO_00 with other fillers (secret, plan, punishment, alcohol, cocaine, custom): revise the postulates first, then lexicalise by predicate, roles and filler sense; no universal verb
+COURT_00 (en): 'court' / 'courtroom' for the ROOM sense to be reviewed
+RACKETEER_00 / +RACKETEERING_00 (es): descriptive phrases until the gloss is confirmed; 'extorsionista' / 'extorsión organizada' if the concept is restricted to extortion
+SEIZE_00 (en): check sense and role direction of 'forfeit' before keeping it as an alias
notes: The generator (src/fgkb_llm/corel/nlg.py, verbalize.py) now renders the COREL indefinite singular 'i' as 'a/an' / 'un/una' (v1.0 wrote 'many' / 'muchos'); this is a code fix, not part of this file.
v1.1 generator fixes: Spanish plural of multi-word noun phrases (head + agreeing adjectives), English 'X of Y' plurals, 'much' / 'mucho' for mass nouns with the quantifier m.
